rows.scope: Pixel RasterizerOrderedByteAddressBuffer, RasterizerOrderedTexture2D<uint>, and RasterizerOrderedStructuredBuffer<uint> with one pixel and three overlapping primitives. The direct MSL ABI attaches raster_order_group(0) to each marked UAV resource.
A four-pixel, four-sample programmable pattern changes raster coverage and resolves to an exact black/red pixel matrix. Broader sample-count/pattern and state interactions remain open.

Two-view pipeline-stream instancing replays validated viewport/render-target array locations and SetViewInstanceMask, with exact per-slice SV_ViewID output. Arbitrary view count/layout and barycentric values remain outside this bounded provider.
Default perspective SV_Barycentrics at the center of a one-pixel full-screen triangle. Noperspective, centroid, sample, and additional barycentric inputs remain fail-closed/outside scope.
The typed provider executes the native16 arithmetic and math cases through Metal half operations. The Options4 report promotes only native16; 64-KB MSAA texture alignment remains fail-closed.

The compute semantic probe passes all declared binary64 arithmetic, IEEE-754 edge, comparison, conversion, unary, predicate, and FMA cases. This is emulation, not native Metal double ALU, and the public report is tied to this provider.

Two R8G8B8A8 render targets with IndependentBlendEnable and a D32 depth attachment with depth writes enabled. Target 0 applies XOR and target 1 applies AND to distinct initialized values; replay binds one Metal global logic operation at a time while masking the other attachments, then performs one state-only depth replay. Pixel shaders with UAV side effects remain fail-closed because draw replay would duplicate those effects.

rows.remaining: Broader unsupported image shapes and rates remain fail-closed.
General geometry/tessellation breadth, all conservative-raster rules, programmable sample-position effects, formats, depth bias, barycentrics, and complete MSAA/raster-state matrices remain open.

ROVsSupported.reason: The ordered UAV provider is implemented and positively probed for the bounded raw-buffer shape, but the public capability remains conservative until the complete ROV resource/stage/state matrix is closed.
